global.title: Rescuing astronomy from its satellite megaconstellation crisis
global.summary: In the late 1800s, long enough ago that it’s almost been forgotten, research astronomy faced an existential crisis brought on by the lighting of cities in the early industrial age. Such electric lighting created strong sky brightness (now called light pollution), which forced research-grade astronomical observatories to move from cities to remote, “dark sky” sites. items.title: Reflect Orbital Buys Two Skyroot Aerospace Launches
items.summary: Reflect Orbital, the startup attempting to offer sunlight on-demand with in-space mirrors, announced the purchase of two launches today from Indian launcher Skyroot Aerospace. The deal includes: One launch on Skyroot’s Vikram-1 launch vehicle, which debuted in July , and can carry ~350kg to LEO. One launch on Skyroot’s upgraded Vikram-1U vehicle, which is expected to fly its first mission in Q1 2027, and will be capable of carrying ~550kg to LEO.
